title: Kobra Save File
description: Companion to <game folder>/data/saves/<slot>.json (spec Section 11.2). Written only by the launcher's data API via temp -> fsync -> verify -> rotate -> rename (FR-SAVE-5); the browser never writes this file. The checksum covers the canonicalised payload only, so header fields such as 'modified' and 'revision' never invalidate an unchanged body.

schema.description: An unknown schema means the file was written by a different product line; refuse to load (Section 12.3).

save_version.description: Save format version. Greater than the engine's value means refuse to load and never write (FR-SAVE-12).

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Save timestamps are never locale-formatted (FR-I18N-3).

modified.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Used for cross-tab conflict detection (FR-SAVE-9); not derived from filesystem mtime, which is coarse on FAT32.

revision.description: Server-owned monotonic revision (FR-SAVE-9). The launcher sets this on every write; a client MUST supply the previous value as if_revision so a concurrent write is rejected with 409 rather than silently overwriting. This replaces v2.0's mtime comparison, which FAT32's 2-second granularity made unreliable.

checksum.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalised payload. Verified on load; a mismatch routes to the .bak recovery chain (Section 11.6).

compression.description: Compression applied to the payload. Only meaningful when payload_ref is used.

payload_ref.description: Sidecar file holding the payload when it exceeds the 1 MiB JSON threshold (FR-SAVE-2). A bare filename relative to saves/; MUST NOT contain a path separator or escape the directory.

payload.description: Engine-defined state. The engine MUST preserve unknown fields on rewrite so an older build can load and re-save a newer save without silent data loss (FR-SAVE-4). When payload_ref is set this object holds only the small header portion of the state.

meta.description: Advisory display metadata. Losing it MUST never mean losing the save; index.json is rebuildable from these fields.

locale_independent_ids.description: Assertion that the payload uses stable numeric IDs rather than display names (FR-I18N-5).

migrations_applied.description: Migration steps already applied to this save, for support diagnostics.

allOf.description: A payload_ref must not be combined with a non-none compression of an inline payload, and must declare its compression.
